title: Slow Cooker Chicken & Chorizo Paella
description: Smoky paprika chicken and rice cooked in the slow cooker, topped with crisp fried chorizo, parmesan and lemon.

method.title: Brown the chicken
method.instruction: Toss the oil, onion, garlic, paprika and chicken together in a large bowl. Heat a large saucepan over medium-high heat and brown the chicken mixture in batches, 2-3 min per batch. Transfer to a 6 L slow cooker.

method.title: Slow cook
method.instruction: Add the tomatoes, stock cubes and 2 cups water. Cover and cook on low for 8 hr (or high for 3 hr), until the chicken is almost tender.

method.title: Add the rice
method.instruction: Stir in the rice and cook on low for 2 hr 25 min (or high for 1 hr 25 min), until the rice is almost tender. Add the peas and olives for the last 10 min.

method.title: Fry the chorizo and serve
method.instruction: Heat a large frying pan over medium-high heat and fry the chorizo, stirring, until browned. Spoon the paella into bowls and top with parsley, lemon zest, chorizo and parmesan. Serve with lemon wedges.

notes: On high the whole thing takes about 4 hr 30 min (3 hr, then 1 hr 25 min with the rice) instead of the 10 hr 35 min on low.
The rice keeps absorbing liquid as it stands. When reheating leftovers, loosen with 2 tbsp water or stock.
